role: External cross-check for the genotype->disease-model table: MGI's Disease Ontology annotations, gene -> DO disease.
limits: GENE-level, unranked, many-to-many. Cannot express allele direction (Myc overexpression vs knockdown) or strain-shaped genotypes (APP/PS1, 5xFAD). Joined to our table by gene symbol; disease names are matched by NORMALIZED LABEL because DO and MONDO share no identifier available locally — MONDO's DOID xrefs would be the rigorous path.
